axis_reconciliation: Numeric GeoTIFF model coordinates are easting,northing and are normalized to EPSG:25830 without coordinate swapping. The EPSG:3042 GeoKey axis-order discrepancy is preserved here.
dataset: IGN MDT05 first LiDAR coverage, 5 m
horizontal_crs_source_metadata: Collection EPSG:25830; GeoTIFF GeoKey EPSG:3042 (same ETRS89/UTM 30 numeric grid with north/east axis declaration)

methods.contours: unsmoothed linear marching-squares segments at 1 m vertical interval
methods.local_aspect: downslope azimuth clockwise from true/grid north; slope-weighted circular aggregation
methods.section: east-west line through polygon centroid, bilinear DEM samples at 5 m
methods.slope: central finite differences on 5 m float32 DEM; percent rise
methods.trend_plane: ordinary least-squares z = ax + by + c over parcel pixel centres

reported_comparison.interpretation: The dossier gradient/aspect reproduce as a least-squares parcel trend plane. Local 5 m cell slopes remain separately reported and are materially higher.

vertical_datum: Alicante orthometric datum realised by EGM2008-REDNAP
